solutionSearchEvidence: The current live Browser already owns movement through centerIds/activeNodes/centerPort/neighbors/nodeWorld and preserves Shield/road identities; this WorkUnit adapts that same authority rather than introducing a second movement engine.
The accepted field is additive: existing field remains selectable and the new symmetric field gets its own setupField identity.

Gate is explicitly not a cell. The new field contains no GATE node id, no Gate stop, and no Gate traversal step. Shared-field ports connect directly to existing Shield identities through neighbor edges; the visual Gate is only a boundary line.

The shared common field is left-right symmetric, colored per-player start markers are absent, and the central-top shared-field point has no direct Shield/Gate edge while remaining part of the common movement graph.
Existing 4 players x 3 Shield-linked lanes x 7 progression identities and existing result/card/resource semantics are preserved.
